title: Chapter 242: Successful Defense
content:
Chapter 242: Successful Defense

On the city wall, the Red Flame Army was ready for battle.

Wang Shuo looked solemn, looked at the guards who jumped down, and rushed up quickly.

"Iron Chain Binding" was launched, followed by another move "Flame Breath".

Wang Shuo knew that the opponent's level was much higher than his, so he did not hold back and directly launched a violent attack like a storm.

"-100"

Fortunately, the damage was dealt.

What Wang Shuo was most worried about was that he could not break the opponent's defense.

Facing the thick-skinned guards, the main output of this battle was still the bronze crossbow cart.

The crossbow cart on the city wall immediately aimed at the guards in front, and a large number of spears were fired. The guards who rushed up the city wall were directly shot down by the crossbow cart.

"Quick, destroy the opponent's cloud ladder." Li Jianguo commanded two catapults and fired two shots at the cloud ladder.

Although the target was hit, the cloud ladder was not directly destroyed.

Several more guards rushed up the city wall, and Gong Zheng, Ayub and others immediately made up to prevent more people from rushing up.

The battle became intense as soon as it started.

As for the ordinary members of the Iron Sword Gate, they cowered behind the guards, avoiding the arrows and didn't dare to rush up.

Ni Wu stood in the distance, hoping that this group of high-level guards could capture the city wall and open the city gate.

As long as the city gate was broken, the battle would be stable.

Wang Shuo naturally knew this, so he fought to the death.

The biggest advantage of fighting in Wana Village is the bonus of the Fountain of Life.

The injured soldiers only need to retreat to a safe place and rest for a while to be fully revived.

Although the battle was very fierce, there were almost no casualties in Wana Village.

As time went on, the second attack of the catapult was ready.

"Bang, bang"

With two loud noises, the ladder was directly blown down.

There were less than 10 guards left on the city wall.

Wang Shuo was very calm.

"Quick, drive them all down."

The 60-level guards would not die if they fell down from the ten-meter-high city wall.

But there was no way to climb up.

As long as these guards were driven down, this battle would be considered a staged victory.

Another bronze spear shot over and shot the last guard off the city wall.

So far, there were no soldiers from Nanshanji on the city wall.

The Tiejianmen gang members under the city wall were directly suppressed by the archers of Wana Village and dared not move forward, and retreated directly out of range.

Seeing that the battle was not going well, Ni Wu's face was very ugly.

But he had no choice.

Nanshanji didn't have many large-scale engineering equipment. He was able to ask Lin Guanru for two ladders, which was already a great favor to him.

Moreover, he had not focused on investigating the situation in Wana Village before, and had never expected that the other side would have such a tall city wall.

"Wang Shuo, if you have the ability, let's come down and fight. Being a coward is not a skill." Ni Wu frowned and shouted loudly.

Wang Shuo stood on the tower and saw that the other party had no stamina to attack. The big stone hanging in his heart finally fell to the ground.

Facing the other party's ridicule, Wang Shuo didn't care.

"Haha, Ni Wu, if you want to fight me, you can."

While talking, Wang Shuo directly ordered Ayub to take the cavalry and quietly leave the city from the back door, intending to take them by surprise.

After a while, the rumbling sound of horse hooves sounded.

When Wang Shuo went to Nanshanji, Ayub had expanded the number of Golden Fire Cavalry to 400. After the experience of the ancient battlefield, the average level reached 28, comparable to the elite of Tiejianmen.

At the same time, quite a number of soldiers also practiced "Zhengyang Jin" and learned a technique to fight to a higher level.

Hearing the abnormal vibration of the ground, the members of Tiejianmen were surprised. After a few breaths, they saw a large group of cavalry whistling over.
